translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

book.name: San Marcos
book.title: Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bacaꞌh San Marcu xcweenta Jesucristu

content: Baluuꞌyi Jwahn nin ruroꞌbañihsa
Squiiꞌ guzaꞌloh dxyiꞌdxyi cuubi nin naa xcweenta Jesucristu, Lliiꞌn Dxiohs.
Bacaꞌh guehtu Isaías squiiꞌ:

content.text: Bwaꞌha ―rahbi Dxiohs loh Lliiꞌn Ñiꞌh― zixeꞌhlaꞌhn mwergaloh nin guiñiꞌ xchiꞌdxyiꞌhn,
laꞌh ba guzee ñiidxiuu tin guunn zaꞌca ba xneziuh luꞌh.
Ziuuꞌ ba tuhbi lahta loh dahan desiertu, ya jweersi rooꞌ zaꞌbi rsiaaꞌha guiñiꞌ ba rsiaaꞌha loh raꞌ bwiinn:

content: Pwihsi biꞌ Jwahn tin baroꞌbañihsa ba laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn nez loh dahan desiertu, ya rahbi Jwahn: ―Gulgasaguuꞌdzi stoꞌ tu nee cun chioobaañihsa za tu, tin ziꞌchi gusiaꞌpitii Dxiohs xtuhlda tu.

Ya laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi Jerusalehn cun garaa raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ Judea biriaꞌh raꞌ ba tin zeegacaꞌdxiahga raꞌ ba dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin rñiꞌ Jwahn, ya cun neezaa baxoꞌbaduhlda raꞌ ba garaa xtuhlda raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi baroꞌbañihsa Jwahn laꞌh raꞌ ba loh guiꞌw Jordahn.
Nin guhca xahba Jwahn naa dxihdxi camehyu, neezaa biyiꞌbi duꞌh tuhbi duꞌhdxihdxi laꞌn tihxi Jwahn, ya nin gudahw Jwahn guhca bwiꞌtsisuu cun dzihn laꞌn dahan,
neezaa rahbi Jwahn loh raꞌ bwiinn: ―Diꞌtsihn ziꞌ stuhbi bwiinn nin lasahcaru loon; ayi lasahcaꞌhn loh bwiinn nin dxiꞌ chi, hasta gacaꞌhn mooza nin cweꞌhe tahba ba ñaaꞌ ba ayi lasahcaꞌhn.
Naꞌh ruroꞌbañiꞌsahn laꞌh tu cun ñihsa, per laꞌh ba cuꞌtii ba Spíritu Saantu laꞌn lastoꞌ tu.
Jwahn baroꞌbañihsa laꞌh Jesuhs
Laꞌn dxyih chigah raꞌ badzihn Jesuhs zeꞌ Ñiꞌh nez guihdxyi Nazaret distrihtu xteenn guihdxyi Galilea, ya baroꞌbañihsa Jwahn laꞌh Ñiꞌh loh guiꞌw Jordahn,
ya loh nin bariaꞌh Jesuhs loh ñihsa, bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh billaala dxibaaꞌ chiꞌchi biehta Spíritu Saantu yihca Jesuhs zigazi tuhbi palohmwiꞌhn.
Hohr chi gahca bihn raꞌ ba tuhbi rsiaaꞌha guñiꞌ Dxiohs nez dxibaaꞌ rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Yiꞌh naa luꞌh Lliiꞌnahn nin nadziiꞌhihn, nee riahxi duuxaꞌhn pur yiꞌh.
Gudxiꞌhyi bwiinndxaaba xa ñusaguiꞌhi ba laꞌh Jesuhs
Ya seguihdu gahca gwanee Spíritu Saantu laꞌh Jesuhs loh tuhbi dahan desiertu,

ya guyuuꞌ Ñiꞌh nez chi chwaꞌha dxyih chwaꞌha gueꞌla nez lahda raꞌ maan duuxa, ya gudxiꞌhyi bwiinndxaaba xa ñusaguiꞌhi ba laꞌh Jesuhs tin ayi ñuzoꞌbadxiahga Ñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs, niꞌchin chin guyaꞌloh bwiꞌhnnee bwiinndxaaba laꞌh Ñiꞌh ziꞌchi, chiꞌchi badzihn raꞌ aanjla raꞌ tin gwanee raꞌ ba xlimentu Jesuhs.
Jesuhs guzoꞌbaloh cayuhnn xtsiꞌn Xtaada Ñiꞌh guihdxyi Galilea
Yaque guyaꞌloh basieꞌw raꞌ ba laꞌh Jwahn nin ruroꞌbañihsa laꞌn latsidxiꞌba, chiꞌchi zee Jesuhs nez guihdxyi Galilea ya riꞌchi guzoꞌbaloh cagaluuꞌyi Ñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi guelrnabwaꞌ xteenn Dxiohs,

rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ bwiinn: ―Laꞌh dxyih nin bacaꞌhbwaꞌ Dxiohs badzihn, pronta guinabwaꞌ Ñiꞌh, niꞌchin gulgasaguuꞌdzi stoꞌ tu pur xtuhlda tu, ya gulchechiistoꞌ tu xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs nin gutaꞌh laꞌh tu loh duhlda.
Jesuhs gudihdxyi laꞌh raꞌ tahpa bwiinn tin gaca raꞌ ba xpwiinn Ñiꞌh

Ya guyuuꞌ tuhbi dxyih zeezah Jesuhs rwaaꞌ ñisadoꞌ xteenn Galilea ya riꞌchi bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh chiohpa bwiinn rigalaꞌh raꞌ ba dxihxi bwehlda loh ñihsa; tuhbi ba laa Simohn ya stuhbi ba naa bwihtsi ba nin laa Andrehs,
chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Gultaaꞌnaꞌhla naꞌh, tin desde nnahdxyih cwiidxi tu bwiinn raꞌ xcweenta xquelrnabwaꞌ Dxiohs xlawaaꞌha riateꞌhe tu bwehlda.
Hohrchi gahca basiaꞌhan raꞌ ba xchihxi bwehlda raꞌ ba ya chiꞌchi zeenee raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs.
Ya mas delaanta ru bwaꞌha Jesuhs laꞌh Jacobo cun laꞌh Jwahn lliiꞌn Zebedeu, rii raꞌ ba cweeꞌ laancha raꞌ ba cagadxihba raꞌ ba dxihxi bwehlda,
ya gudihdxyi Jesuhs laꞌh raꞌ ba tin chenaꞌhla raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh, ya basiaꞌhan raꞌ ba Zebedeu xtaada raꞌ ba hasta zuu xlaancha ba cun xmooza ba, ya chiꞌchiyi zeenee Jacobo cun Jwahn laꞌh Jesuhs.
Xcweenta tuhbi ndxiꞌhw nin babweꞌhe Jesuhs tuhbi bwiinndxaaba stoꞌ ñiꞌh guihdxyi Capernaum

Chin badzihnnee raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs guihdxyi Capernaum, chiꞌchi badzihn dxyih nin ruziꞌlaaꞌdzi raꞌ bwiinn Israel raꞌ, nee gwah Jesuhs laꞌn xquidoꞌ biꞌtiꞌhn raꞌ ba tin baluuꞌyi Ñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn,
ya badxyigaaꞌ loh raꞌ bwiinn chi ziga forma nin baluuꞌyi Ñiꞌh laꞌh raꞌ ba zigapaꞌh tuhbi bwiinn nin rnabwaꞌ, ayi ziga dxiꞌh ruhnn raꞌ mwehsu raꞌ nin ruluuꞌyi xlehyi Moisehs,
nee laꞌn guidoꞌ chi zuu tuhbi ndxiꞌhw nin guyuuꞌ tuhbi bwiinndxaaba stoꞌ ñiꞌh, ya gudidxyidxiah bwiinndxaaba nin nuu stoꞌ ndxiꞌhw chi rahbi ba:
―¡Ayy, basaaꞌn laꞌh nu ayi xi guunnee luꞌh laꞌh nu, Jesuhs nin zeꞌ guihdxyi Nazaret! ¿Xixnaa zeꞌgañichiloh luꞌh laꞌh nu? ¡Naꞌh nuꞌnbwaꞌn yiꞌh, yiꞌh nin naa luꞌh Bwiinn Saantu nin guluꞌnehza Dxiohs!
Chiꞌchi gudxyildxyineedxyiꞌdxyi Jesuhs laꞌh bwiinndxaaba chi rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―¡Bataꞌw rwaaꞌ luꞌh tin bariaꞌh stoꞌ bwiinn ca!
Chin bihn bwiinndxaaba chi dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ riiꞌ, gudxiindxiah bwiinndxaaba chi laꞌh ndxiꞌhw chi, chiꞌchi gudidxyidxiah bwiinndxaaba chi chin bariaꞌh ba stoꞌ bwiinn chi,
ya garaa raꞌ ba badxyigaaꞌ loh raꞌ ba rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¿Xi niꞌca raꞌ? ¡Pwehda nacuubi raꞌ dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ riiꞌ nin ruluuꞌyi ba, ya hasta bwiinndxaaba raꞌ ruzoꞌbadxiahga xchiꞌdxyi ba!
Ya lwehgu bidiꞌchi dxyiꞌdxyi xcweenta nin bwiꞌhnn Jesuhs loh garaa raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ xteenn distrihtu Galilea.
Basiaca Jesuhs laꞌh xnaanswehgra Simohn Pehdru
Chin bariaꞌh Jesuhs laꞌn guidoꞌ biꞌtiꞌhn chi, chiꞌchi zenee Ñiꞌh Jacobo cun Jwahn cun snuhn raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh yihdzi Simohn cun Andrehs,
ya xnaanswehgra Simohn jweertarooꞌ nuu ba lliaꞌh, ya chin badzihn Jesuhs chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh nuu naaniꞌhn chi lliaꞌh,

chiꞌchi guyuuꞌtii Ñiꞌh hasta naꞌ ba, ya gunaꞌzu Ñiꞌh naa ba tin gutestii Ñiꞌh laꞌh ba, ya hohra chi gahca bariaꞌh lliaꞌh chi tihxi naaniꞌhn chi, chiꞌchi gwastii ba tin bwiꞌhnnchaꞌyi ba nin gudahw raꞌ ba.
Basiaca Jesuhs ziahan raꞌ bwiinn nin rahcalluꞌhu
Ya hohra nin zohbayaꞌzi gubihdxyi, para cwih gueꞌla la hohra chi gwanee raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi garaa raꞌ bwiinn nin rahcalluꞌhu cun nin nuu raꞌ bwiinndxaaba stoꞌ raꞌ Ñiꞌh,
ya badiaaꞌha gaduhbi guihdxyi raꞌ ba rwaaꞌ yuuꞌ hasta nuu Jesuhs,

ya basiaca Jesuhs garaaloh gueldxyihdxyi nin rahca raꞌ ziahan bwiinn, ya laasii nuꞌnbwaꞌ raꞌ bwiinndxaaba raꞌ chi chyu naa Jesuhs, niꞌchin nin ayi basaaꞌn Ñiꞌh ñiñiꞌ raꞌ bwiinndxaaba chi chyu naa Ñiꞌh.
Jesuhs baluuꞌyi xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ Galilea
Ya chin barah gueꞌla, rsiiyidoꞌ run biriaꞌh Jesuhs guihdxyi chi tin gwah Ñiꞌh tuhbi lahta hasta ayi chyu bwiinn nuuꞌ tin gudihdxi-gunaaba Ñiꞌh laꞌh Xtaada Dxiohs Ñiꞌh.
Ya seguihdu Simohn cun snuhn raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh bagadxiꞌhyi raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh,
ya chin badxeela raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh rahbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh: ―Ziahan raꞌ bwiinn xclaaꞌdzi gwaꞌha yiꞌh.

Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Gulchooꞌho guihdxyi raꞌ nin riaꞌhan raꞌ gahxu tin nahpa guluꞌyiꞌhn xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ chi tin niꞌchin guluꞌnehza Dxiohs naꞌh loh guidxyiyuh.

Ya ziꞌchi gucaꞌnzaa Jesuhs gaduhbi nehza guihdxyi Galilea tin baluuꞌyi Ñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs laꞌn guidoꞌ biꞌtuꞌhn raꞌ xteenn raꞌ guihdxyi raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ guihdxyi Galilea, neezaa babweꞌhe Ñiꞌh bwiinndxaaba raꞌ stoꞌ raꞌ nuu raꞌ bwiinn.
Basiaca Jesuhs laꞌh tuhbi bwiinn nin rahchyi guiiꞌdxiu tihxi ñiꞌh

Ya tuhbi dxyih, gwah tuhbi ndxiꞌhw nin rahchyi guiiꞌdxiu gaduhbitiiꞌ tihxi ñiꞌh loh Jesuhs, tin bazuꞌnllihbi ba nez loh Jesuhs ya chiꞌchi guñiꞌnalaasa ba loh Ñiꞌh rahbi ba: ―Naꞌh naꞌnnahn zuhnn luꞌh gahn gusiaca luꞌh naꞌh sidela ziziꞌguehlda luꞌh ―rahbi ndxiꞌhw chi.
Ya balahsastoꞌ Jesuhs laꞌh ndxiꞌhw chi, chiꞌchi basagaꞌh Ñiꞌh naa Ñiꞌh tin cun naa Ñiꞌh bidxiꞌ Ñiꞌh tihxi ba chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh bwiinn chi: ―Xclaaꞌdzihn gusiaꞌcahn yiꞌh; laꞌluꞌh biaca.
Ya chin guyaꞌloh guñiꞌ Ñiꞌh ziꞌchi lwehgu si guñichiloh gueldxyihdxyi chi tihxi ndxiꞌhw chi,
ya gunabwaꞌ Jesuhs loh ba ayi xi guuyitiiꞌ ba loh raꞌ bwiinn nin basiaca Ñiꞌh laꞌh ba,

chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh ba: ―Sola chee luꞌh loh bixohza tin gwaꞌha ba laꞌluꞌh biaca, ya chin chaꞌloh gwaꞌha ba tihxi luꞌh, badiꞌhi tuhbi guelrgaaꞌda ziga rnabwaꞌ xlehyi Moisehs tin gacabwaꞌ raꞌ bwiinn laꞌluꞌh biaca.

Per laꞌh ndxiꞌhw chi ayi gudxihpa stoꞌ ba, mahzi ru batiꞌchi ba dxyiꞌdxyi xcweenta nin basiaca Jesuhs laꞌh ba. Niꞌchin nin biaꞌhan Jesuhs loh dahan laasii ayi ñahca ñiuꞌgarii Ñiꞌh labwenutiiꞌ, laasii ñutaꞌwnaa raꞌ bwiinn laꞌh Ñiꞌh bwiinn garaa nehza nin zeeguiꞌha laꞌh Ñiꞌh.
